mathematics.assertion_tested: The original Cartesian static adjoint Faddeev-Popov action gives the displayed J=1 R/E/M matrix; its smooth-origin framed Dirichlet determinant equals the derived elementary RE and M formulas, checked independently at the declared finite radii.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact rational/algebraic expressions and formal radial functions for Cartesian and BPS identities; IEEE double DOP853; 70-digit mpmath quadrature.
mathematics.conventions: D_i=partial_i+A_i cross, A_i=(1-K)(e_i cross n)/r, Phi=h n; K=r/sinh r,h=coth r-1/r. Reduced norm dr. Cartesian J1 basis R=n n_z,E=(e_z-n n_z)/sqrt2,M=n cross e_z/sqrt2. Matrix ODE uses E,R order. Origin l0 and l2 columns normalized in e0=(sqrt2,1)/sqrt3,e2=(-1,sqrt2)/sqrt3; free determinant x^4. Magnetic l1 normalized r^2; free determinant x^2. All outer ghost fields Dirichlet, no zero eigenvalue removed.
